unsupported_expected_archetypes.recommended_extension: Add STAFF_TURNOVER_COST_SPIRAL DiagnosisType covering high-frequency field-staff churn with measurable training and recruiting cost drain and service quality deterioration.

evidence_items.finding: 3 open field staff positions ongoing at any given time, consuming significant owner time
evidence_items.rationale: Persistent unfilled positions is a team_capability critical signal. is_critical=true; HIGH confidence.

evidence_items.finding: service quality complaints increasing as undertrained staff fill operational gaps
evidence_items.rationale: Quality complaints from undertrained staff is a critical quality_delivery signal. is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: lost 3 commercial contracts citing inconsistent service quality
evidence_items.rationale: Contract losses from quality issues are a critical customer_retention adverse signal. is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: owner unable to focus on business growth due to constant recruiting and training demands
evidence_items.rationale: Owner time consumed by recruiting is an operational bottleneck. operational_efficiency; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: 22 field staff; annual turnover rate 140%; onboarding cost $1,800 per new employee; 3 ongoing open positions; owner spends 15 hours/week recruiting; 11 service complaints last quarter; 3 commercial contracts lost; $87K revenue lost from contracts
evidence_items.rationale: 140% annual turnover on 22 staff means effectively replacing the entire workforce 1.4 times per year at $1,800/hire. is_critical=true; HIGH confidence. Avoids must_identify terms ('staff turnover', '140% annual turnover', 'turnover cost', 'retention failure', 'training cost per hire', 'recruiting consuming owner capacity').

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue appears roughly flat, not visibly declining
evidence_items.rationale: Flat revenue is a misleading signal. The cost spiral from turnover is the real problem, not yet visible in top-line revenue.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): demand for services remains high in the local market
evidence_items.rationale: Market demand is a misleading signal — good demand does not compensate for the operational and retention problems.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): owner interprets high turnover as normal for the industry
evidence_items.rationale: Industry-normal framing is a misleading signal that normalizes an abnormal and costly pattern.

validation_notes: SMB-009 is an archetype-gap case. Engine has no STAFF_TURNOVER_COST_SPIRAL archetype. team_capability items may trigger key_person_risk pattern but without keyPersonCount/successionReady numerics the pattern will not fire with HIGH confidence. quality_delivery items may trigger quality_control_failure if complaint vocabulary matches. Engine will most likely return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or an adjacent archetype. This is expected — case is abstention_eligible. Must_identify terms avoided: 'staff turnover', '140% annual turnover', 'turnover cost', 'retention failure', 'training cost per hire', 'recruiting consuming owner capacity'. evidence_items[4] previously leaked 'training cost per hire' (100% token match) — fixed to 'onboarding cost $1,800 per new employee'.
